digest.component_or_area: autodeploy disk-pressure reclaim and blue-green container retirement
propositions: Disk-pressure reclaim logs success without freeing space because tagged blue-green release images are never retired, only dangling images are pruned.
The automatic reclaim cannot self-heal disk pressure because build cache retention and tagged-image accumulation dominate the leak and nothing is permitted to remove them.
Observability cannot distinguish reclaim-never-ran from reclaim-ran-and-freed-nothing because the marker counts invocations, not bytes freed.
Per-release images must be retired by reading the exact image reference from docker inspect before reaping the container, then removing the image only after successful container removal.
Reclaim effectiveness is unobservable because prune_docker_caches does not log root-disk free space before and after, preventing measurement of effect.
Persistent ineffective reclaim cycles are indistinguishable from transient pressure because no marker tracks multiple consecutive cycles in which pressure persists across reclaim.
